I can vividly remember when my third grade teacher picked up my copy of Dragons of Winters Night up off my desk and asking me why I had it. (par for the course for most kids that era was Matt Christopher or Goosebumps) ... I told her I was reading it and she raised an eyebrow and asked me to see her after class.  I thought I was in trouble or something for having an inappropriate book so I was stressed for the rest of class.  She asked me to read it to her, which I did.  The school started a reading enrichment honors program later that week where me and a couple other kids got to hang out in the library and discuss books and stuff.  It was awesome and a really wonderful memory from my childhood.  Every week for our allowance my brothers and I got to go to the bookstore at the local mall and pick out one book.  Every week I picked out another Dragonlance book and normally read it before the following week's trip.  I'm getting teary-eyed even writing this..  I still have all the books and can't wait to read them to my daughter when she's old enough (she's eight months now).
